anchors.locked_description: a young Arab man with an angular face, deep brown eyes, short curly black hair, and a thin scar above the left eyebrow
a weathered olive wool cloak over a dark linen tunic, brown leather belt, and worn boots
one pale ivory dragon with lavender tones, dusty pink wing membranes, a long neck, swept-back horns, four legs, and two wings
a medieval mountain village courtyard with a stone well on the left, a timber gate at the far center, and a small stone house on the right
photorealistic fantasy film look, muted earth colors, soft overcast daylight, natural atmospheric haze

shots.intent: The hero stops the frightened villagers from attacking the dragon.
